concepts.label: vtep-binding
concepts.gloss: An attachment on a VTEP that binds a specific overlay-segment (VNI) to the VTEP by mapping the VNI to that VTEP.

concepts.label: overlay-segment
concepts.gloss: A logical overlay-segment (L2-domain) identified by a VNI that is realized by a vtep-binding.

concepts.label: vtep-node
concepts.gloss: A vtep-node (VTEP) acting as a tunnel endpoint that hosts vtep-bindings connecting overlay segments to the local VTEPs.

concepts.label: overlay-mtu
concepts.gloss: An overlay-mtu framing setting that applies to the overlay-segment (VNI).

concepts.label: anycast-gateway
concepts.gloss: An anycast-gateway is an L3 gateway that provides a common gateway for the overlay-segment (VNI).

concepts.label: microseg-policy
concepts.gloss: A microseg-policy that applies to an overlay-segment (VNI) to implement micro-segmentation.

concepts.label: security-zone
concepts.gloss: A security-zone is a policy-group that groups microsegmentation policies into a named security domain.

concepts.label: vertex-tag-6
concepts.gloss: A vertex-tag-6 is an opaque vendor-tag carried on the overlay-segment (VNI).
